newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures erase losses, near highs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures erase losses, near highs.

text.p: March 17 - U.S. stock index futures erased losses, hit peaks in busy late trade. June S&P 500s drew support from the late rebound in T-bond futures, which ended on pit-session highs. June S&P 500s hit buystops near 802.00 on good-size dealer buying and bounced above last Friday's high at 805.30 after holding trendline support at 789.00. Arb buy programs seen.
